In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the best molecular descriptor is a combination of paths of lengths 1, 3 and 4 with variable weights x = 0, 0, 2, 0, respectively.
the optimal weight for carbon-oxygen bonds is in the range 0.6 – 0.9, depending on property.
for all the examined molecular properties, the optimal variable weight x is 0.5.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the optimal variable weight is 0.5 for all properties except for log γ, for which the optimal variable weight was found to be equal to 1.
for all the properties considered the best regression results are obtained by the use of molecular descriptors based on paths with variable weight.
the optimal weight for carbon-oxygen bonds in alcohols is 0.5.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the optimal weight x depends on molecular property and is not universal.
the variable weight x = 2 is optimal for log S and log P and x = 1 for CSA and log γ.
for some properties, such as log S, log P and log γ, the optimal weight x is close to 1, which means that the optimal descriptor is the length of the longest path in the molecule.
